mil3.7.1:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, katihi ākārehi sati uppajjatīti. -
mil3.7.1:1.5: abhijānato pi mahārāja sati uppajjati, kaṭumikāya pi sati uppajjati, oḷārikaviññāṇato pi sati uppajjati, hitaviññāṇato pi sati uppajjati, ahitaviññāṇato pi sati uppajjati, sabhāganimittato pi sati uppajjati, visabhāganimittato pi sati uppajjati, kathābhiññāṇato pi sati uppajjati, lakkhaṇato pi sati uppajjati, saraṇato pi sati uppajjati, muddāto pi sati uppajjati, gaṇanāto pi sati uppajjati, dhāraṇato pi sati uppajjati, bhāvanāto pi sati uppajjati, potthakanibandhanato pi sati uppajjati, upanikkhepato pi sati uppajjati, anubhūtato pi sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:2.2: yathā mahārāja āyasmā ca Ānando Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā ye vā pan' aññe pi keci jātissarā jātiṃ saranti, evaṃ abhijānato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:3.2: yo pakatiyā muṭṭhassatiko pare ca taṃ sarāpanatthaṃ nibandhanti, evaṃ kaṭumikāya sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:4.2: yadā rajje vā abhisitto hoti sotāpattiphalaṃ vā patto hoti, evaṃ oḷārikaviññāṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:5.2: yamhi sukhāpito: amukasmiṃ evaṃ sukhāpito ti sarati, evaṃ hitaviññāṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:6.2: yamhi dukkhāpito: amukasmiṃ evaṃ dukkhāpito ti sarati, evaṃ ahitaviññāṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:7.2: sadisaṃ puggalaṃ disvā mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā bhātaraṃ vā bhaginiṃ vā sarati, oṭṭhaṃ vā goṇaṃ vā gadrabhaṃ vā disvā aññaṃ tādisaṃ oṭṭhaṃ vā goṇaṃ vā gadrabhaṃ vā sarati, evaṃ sabhāganimittato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:8.2: asukassa nāma [evaṃ] vaṇṇo ediso, saddo ediso, gandho ediso, raso ediso, phoṭṭhabbo ediso ti sarati, evaṃ visabhāganimittato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:9.2: yo pakatiyā muṭṭhassatiko hoti taṃ pare sarāpenti, tena so sarati, evaṃ kathābhiññāṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:10.2: yo balivaddānaṃ ankena jānāti lakkhaṇena jānāti, evaṃ lakkhaṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:11.2: yo pakatiyā muṭṭhassatiko hoti, yo taṃ: sarāhi bho, sarāhi bho ti punappunaṃ sarāpeti, evaṃ saraṇato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:12.2: lipiyā sikkhitattā jānāti: imassa akkharassa anantaraṃ imaṃ akkharaṃ kātabban-ti, evaṃ muddāto sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:13.2: gaṇanāya sikkhitattā gaṇakā bahum-pi gaṇenti, evaṃ gaṇanāto sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:14.2: dhāraṇāya sikkhitattā dhāraṇakā bahum-pi dhārenti, evaṃ dhāranato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:15.2: idha bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ:
mil3.7.1:15.4: iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, evaṃ bhāvanāto sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:16.2: rājāno anusāsaniyaṃ anussarantā: ekaṃ potthakaṃ āharathāti tena potthakena anussaranti, evaṃ potthakanibandhanato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:17.2: upanikkhittaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ disvā sarati, evaṃ upanikkhepato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:18.2: diṭṭhattā rūpaṃ sarati, sutattā saddaṃ sarati, ghāyitattā gandhaṃ sarati, sāyitattā rasaṃ sarati, phuṭṭhattā phoṭṭhabbaṃ sarati, viññātattā dhammaṃ sarati, evaṃ anubhūtato sati uppajjati.
mil3.7.1:18.3: Imehi kho mahārāja soḷasahi ākārehi sati uppajjatīti. -
